senses.gloss: ch. sameto grab, take a fistful.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 2:2">Targ. Lev. II, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 5:12">V, 12</cite>.—
<cite ref="Menachot 11a:13">Men. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>כדקַמְצֵי אינשי</he> as people ordinarily grab (putting the hand in and taking a handful of flower out).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5">Gen. R. s. 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01459"><he>חֲפַן</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:1:2">Y. Sabb. XIV, beg. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>דו קָמֵיץ חדא וכ׳</he> for it (the deer in sleep) closes one eye &c., v. preced.—Part. pass. <he>קְמִיץ</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 8:14">Targ. Cant. VIII, 14</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 50a:5">Ḥull. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>קְמוֹץ הב וכ׳</he> scrape the surface off and give me (the fat) to eat.
<cite ref="Chullin 50a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>קַמְצוּ וכ׳</he> they scraped the surface off and &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 63a">Ber. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>קְמֹץ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="S00039"><he>קבוץ</he></cite>; Ms. F. <cite ref="S01721"><he>קפוץ</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="G00174"><he>זוּל</he></cite> I ch.
